title: Compact preflight compatibility fingerprint and LTS gating checker
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a fast, deterministic preflight runner that produces a compact ‘fingerprint’ and gating verdict for uploads and rollouts. This ticket scopes a lightweight end-to-end check that combines: (1) golden-path smoke probes (API sanity + auth + routing), (2) perf microbench (90th/99th latency probe over representative short sequences), and (3) behavioral regression checks against a small curated prompt suite. The runner must compare results to the LTS baseline and emit a machine-readable artifact (fingerprint + assertions) that gate deployment automations and the Console rollouts UI.

Why: Current preflight suites are comprehensive but slow (30–90m). We need a fast preflight (5–12m) for frequent canaries and CI gated merges that can block obvious regressions while deferring slower full-eval runs to the release pipeline.

Scope and requirements:
- Compact runner runs in <=12 minutes on dedicated smoke pool.
- Produces a fingerprint JSON (sha256 of: model-binary-checksum, kernel-version, serving-config, and aggregated signal vector) and a human-readable summary.
- Signals included: smoke_ok (bool), kv_cache_validation (bool), latency_p90_ms (int), latency_p99_ms (int), throughput_rps (int), behavioral_regressions (list of prompt ids with score deltas), model_version, runtime_build_id.
- Baseline comparison: read LTS-channel baseline from s3://redwood-preflight/lts-baselines/<lts-channel>/latest.json and fail if any P0 assertions violated (latency delta >25% or behavioral score drop >5 points for any high-sensitivity prompt).
- Integrations: post artifact to Confluence release page, create GitHub PR comment with verdict, and write event to EventBus for Console to pick up (schema: fingerprint_v1). (See links to artifacts below.)

Acceptance criteria:
1) End-to-end runner prototype implemented in CI and runnable locally via `scripts/preflight/run_compact.sh`.
2) Artifact produced matches schema and uploaded to S3; checksum validated in CI run.
3) Console gating UI can read verdict (manual smoke demo done with Console QA).

Non-goals: This ticket does not replace full perf eval harness, long-run regression suites, or A/B traffic experiments. It is a fast gate for obvious regressions only.

Artifacts and references:
- Design notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Compact+Preflight+Design
- Baseline manifest format: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/LTS+Baseline+Schema
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12345
comments: 2026-02-16 — Maya Chen: Scoped the initial set of prompts. Chosen 18 prompts covering: short chat, instruction-to-code, completion with stop sequences, and basic extraction. Marked 6 as high-sensitivity (affects safety/clarity).

2026-02-20 — Lucas Rivera: Implemented the smoke probes and KV cache validation harness. Found an intermittent 15% latency variance on p99 when warmup missing — added a warmup prefix step. PR opened: runtime#12345.
2026-02-26 — Priya Anand (QA): Ran local preflight against runtime-1.18-lts baseline; one behavioral delta on prompt ID P-07 (clarity score -6). Marked as P0 regression candidate and triaged with PM.

2026-03-01 — Jamie Ortiz (PM): Reviewed acceptance criteria. Agreed to strict gating on latency>25% and behavioral drop>5 for high-sensitivity prompts. For non-high-sensitivity prompts, fail only if drop>12.

2026-03-03 — Lucas Rivera: Added S3 upload and fingerprint sha256 manifest generation. Hooked to CI step `ci/preflight-compact`. Verified upload to s3://redwood-preflight/compact/2026-03-03/ENG-324567.json.

2026-03-05 — Security review (Ana Gomez): Quick review complete. No secrets in artifact; verified that runtime_build_id and model checksum are safe to publish internally. Recommended redaction flag for public artifacts.

Next steps: Add Console integration event (EventBus schema) and an automated GitHub PR check that blocks merges when verdict.status == 'fail' — follow-up ticket recommended for GitHub app integration.
